facts.fact: Nikolai 视角：城墙归他，他把它当作乐器来指挥——「放！」三百张弓弦同时响起。
facts.anchor: The wall was mine, and I ran it like an instrument.

facts.fact: 他在城墙上远远望见龙背上的 Max 在流血：肩膀一片深色的湿痕顺袖而下——那景象在他体内点起一股冷怒。
facts.anchor: She was bleeding. Her shoulder, a dark wet bloom spreading down her sleeve, and the sight of it lit a cold fury in me.

facts.fact: 前塔一声长而低的号角——Aelindor 下令召龙回城。
facts.anchor: From the front tower a horn called, long and low. Aelindor, ordering the dragon home.

facts.fact: 一段外墙像世界裂开一样向内塌陷，把站在上面的弩炮班一起埋进瓦砾。
facts.anchor: One stretch of the outer wall folded in on itself with a sound like the world cracking

facts.fact: 战果清点：两百多名士兵与军官阵亡——按战争的冷算术，这是「轻价」。
facts.anchor: Over two hundred of our soldiers and officers had fallen.

facts.fact: 而他写下：从来没有觉得轻——名单上每一个名字都会是别人的爱人、父母、儿女、朋友。
他的判断：白女巫只是往城墙上投了一支探针，学到她想学的东西，就会再来，直到把 Covenant 烧成灰。
facts.anchor: The White Witch had thrown a probe at our walls, learned what she came to learn

facts.fact: 龙重重落在场心，Max 从龙背上翻下站定：浑身是血、那缕白发被染成绿色——而她站得笔直、下巴抬起。
facts.anchor: She was glorious. She was alive.

facts.fact: 章末他直接从高墙跳下，落在血染的地上，向她走去。
facts.anchor: I stepped off the high wall, dropped the long fall to the bloodied ground, and went to her.
